# Shuush

> Open-source local Superwhisper & Wispr Flow alternative for Linux and Wayland, built cleanly on top of MIT-licensed voxtype (https://github.com/peteonrails/voxtype).

## Canonical URLs
- Site: https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/
- Writing Index: https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/blog/
- 1-Line Installer: https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/install.sh
- Pre-Flight Doctor: https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/doctor.sh
- Launch Blog & Benchmarks: https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/blog/why-we-built-shuush/
- Anti-Paraphrase Span Gate Architecture: https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/blog/anti-paraphrase-span-gate/
- Omarchy & Hyprland Superwhisper Guide: https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/blog/omarchy-hyprland-superwhisper-alternative/
- RSS Feed: https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/rss.xml
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/KitsuneKode/shuush

## Verified Facts & Benchmarks
- License: MIT (100% open-source, unlimited words, $0)
- Operating Systems: Linux Wayland (Hyprland, Omarchy, Sway, Niri, Arch Linux) + first-party kuwai rice support
- GPU Backends (via stock voxtype-bin): NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm/Vulkan, Intel Vulkan, CPU
- Speech Engines (via stock voxtype-bin): Parakeet Unified EN 0.6B fp16, Whisper large-v3-turbo, Cohere Transcribe GGUF, Moonshine
- Measured daily-driver telemetry (Intel i5-13450HX, RTX 4050 Laptop 6 GB VRAM, 23 GiB RAM):
  - 333 real takes, 19,498 words dictated (~8.1 hours saved vs 40 WPM typing)
  - 516 ms P50 / 1,060 ms P90 end-to-end cleanup latency (24 ms when already clean)
  - 98.8% cleanup reliability; ~2.3 GB resident CUDA VRAM
- Architecture:
  1. Local ASR via stock voxtype (zero fork required)
  2. 5-source bounded context: App + AT-SPI <screen>/<draft> + highlighted <selection> + fresh <=15s <clipboard> + <now>
  3. Deterministic anti-paraphrase span gate (voxtype_pp_gate.py) + 1-click Air-Gapped Ollama mode or multi-provider failover
  4. Phonetic grounded self-learning (voxtype_learn.py) synced into voxtype config.toml [text] replacements + native GTK4 Studio
